product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Classic Prep Bowls with Lids, Set of 4, Empire Red
features: SET OF 4: This set of four prep bowls includes 1-cup (8 ounces), 2-cup (16 ounces), 3-cup (24 ounce) and 4-cup (32 ounce) sizes, perfect for storing small amounts fruits, vegetables, cheese, herbs and other ingredients before you begin cooking
PLASTIC COVERS INCLUDED: Each of these bowls feature a clear, plastic cover that helps easily identify contents, making them great for storing small amounts of leftover ingredients or food
DURABLE, LIGHTWEIGHT CONSTRUCTION: Made from durable, lightweight plastic, these bowls make great to-go containers for sides dishes, dressings and sauces
EASY TO STORE: These small bowls nest together when not in use for easy, space saving, compact storage
DISHWASHER SAFE: Prep bowls and lids are dishwasher safe (top rack recommended) for fast and easy clean up
Included components: 4 Prep Bowls with Lids
description: This KitchenAid prep bowl set is perfect for prepping and storing all your vegetables, herbs and other ingredients before you begin cooking. This set of four prep bowls includes 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-cup sizes. These bowls feature clear plastic covers to easily identify contents. These prep bowls are constructed of durable, lightweight plastic. These bowls nest together when not in use for easy storage. These prep bowls are dishwasher safe for fast and easy cleanup. One year hassle-free replacement and lifetime limited.
